name: Astribot S1
summary:
Astribot S1 is an AI robotics platform built around coordinated manipulation and integrated hardware-software development. Astribot calls its approach Design for AI: the physical mechanisms and control system are developed together to support learning and responsive interaction with objects and people. The product emphasizes compliant, precise movement rather than movement demonstrations alone.

S1 also serves as a development platform for embodied-intelligence research. Its workflow links data collection, model training and deployment, with teleoperation tools for recording examples of tasks.

description.en:
Astribot S1 is an AI robotics platform built around coordinated manipulation and integrated hardware-software development. Astribot calls its approach Design for AI: the physical mechanisms and control system are developed together to support learning and responsive interaction with objects and people. The product emphasizes compliant, precise movement rather than movement demonstrations alone.

S1 also serves as a development platform for embodied-intelligence research. Its workflow links data collection, model training and deployment, with teleoperation tools for recording examples of tasks. Astribot positions the system as a way for teams to validate robot-learning applications and develop useful manipulation skills, with the delivered behavior dependent on task-specific training and integration.
